summary: John's maternal 2nd great-grandmother; widowed head of the Ferlaino boarding house for San Mango newcomers at 1306 Diamond Avenue, Scranton.
bio: Tree: Giuseppina Fiorillo (1871-1943), daughter of Domenico Fiorillo (1840-1927) + Saveria Colosimo (1848-1926), wife of Leopoldo Ferlaino. 1920 census (Scranton Ward 2, ED 105, sheet 2A, 1306 Diamond Avenue): Josephine 'Farino', head, 45, widowed, owns house free of mortgage, born Italy, immigrated 1900, alien; with daughter Helen (25), son Frank (17), daughter 'Rofella' (15), son-in-law Frank Cognetti, three grandsons and boarders Anthony 'Bifano' (Epifano) and Angelo Bonacci. The census age points to birth c.1874-75 rather than the tree's 1871. A forum post says 1306 Diamond Ave was the home of the Ferlaino family who took in boarders from San Mango d'Aquino in the 1910s-20s. Arrived with Helen in 1900 (1920 census) or 1901 (1930 census). No San Mango cemetery entry for her, consistent with death in Scranton.
